### F1041 · `P1` · The Upload screen's 'Buy credits' button is a dead link for every non-admin who can upload
*Upload screen credits bar entry point (.up-credits-bar → openBuyCredits()) — broken-affordance · incubator · effort S · found on review*

- **Gap** — Two defects in one. (1) Parity: the credit-purchase action the prototype gives PM and PA does not exist for those roles at all, on any screen. (2) A live UX bug independent of the prototype — the repo ships a primary-styled button (it even turns `variant="primary"` when the balance is low, i.e. it shouts loudest exactly when it is most broken) that every non-admin uploader can see and click, and it lands on a 403 empty state. The auditor examined this lane's upload entry point in the brief's scope list but reported nothing about it.
- **Prototype** — live-panels/AISJ_IC_SuserV15/panel-upload.html:154-166 — .up-credits-bar with 'Credits balance — 3 remaining', '3 free trial credits · Standard plan', a progress bar and two buttons, the second `onclick="openBuyCredits()"`. openBuyCredits() (_scripts.js:3068-3072) opens the account overlay at the plan step in pay-as-you-go mode. The same bar with the same Buy-credits button is present in AISJ_IC_PM_V5/panel-upload.html and AISJ_IC_PA_V3/panel-upload.html (1 openBuyCredits hit each), i.e. the prototype gives the purchase action to Program Manager and Program Associate, not just the superuser. (The VC upload panels have no credits bar at all.)
- **Repository** — src/client/routes/UploadPage.tsx:202 renders `<CreditsBar credits={credits} />` unconditionally — no role check — and CreditsBar at lines 499-527 wraps the button in `<Link to="/app/billing">`. But src/shared/nav.ts:111 and :178 gate `{ id: "billing", label: "Buy credits" }` to `roles: ["admin"]`, and src/server/routes/config.ts:389 gates POST /api/config/credits/purchase with requireRole("admin"). Upload itself is open to program_manager and program_associate (src/shared/nav.ts:51). So a PM or PA clicking Buy credits is routed by src/client/routes/guards.tsx:33-41 to the 'Not available for your role' EmptyState, with no back-link and no explanation.
- **Fix** — Pick one: (a) open `billing` to the roles that can see `upload` in src/shared/nav.ts:111 (and relax requireRole on POST /api/config/credits/purchase accordingly), or (b) in CreditsBar, call canAccessNav(edition, role, "billing") and, when false, replace the Link with disabled text such as 'Ask an admin to top up' — keeping the balance visible, which issue 11 intended. Add an e2e assertion that a PA on /app/upload never sees a control that resolves to the RequireNav 403.

### F1042 · `P1` · The '3 free decks' free trial is never modelled or named anywhere in the product
*acs-account / acs-plan / acs-payment / acs-success (free-trial thread) — functionality · effort M · found on review*

- **Gap** — The seeded 3 credits are a coincidence of the demo seed, not a trial. Nothing grants a trial on account creation, nothing labels the first three decks as free, and nothing distinguishes trial credits from purchased ones — so the four prototype surfaces that advertise it, and the Upload sub-line that reports it, have no data to render. The auditor counted the acs-plan trial strip as one missing block inside finding #13, but not the absence of the underlying concept.

- **Repository** — `grep -rni trial src/` returns ZERO hits across the whole client, server and shared code. migrations/0002_seed.sql:11-13 seeds credits_balance = 3 for both editions but with no trial semantics, no grant event and no expiry/consumption distinction. src/client/routes/UploadPage.tsx:512-518 shows only 'Credits balance — N remaining / Each deck evaluated uses one credit' with no trial sub-line, no progress bar and no 'Balance' button.
- **Fix** — Add a trial grant to the account/org record (e.g. trial_credits_granted + granted_at on org_settings, or a credit_grants table distinguishing trial from purchased), surface it in the config summary, and render the strip on the account/plan/payment/success screens plus the Upload sub-line. Cheap to add now, expensive later once billing exists.

### F1057 · `P2` · The Team step's only call to action points Program Managers and Associates at a screen their role cannot open

Not caught by the claim-2 finding, which treats the EmptyState purely as evidence that seat/plan controls are absent and never checks whether its redirect target is reachable by the roles that see it.

But src/shared/nav.ts:110 gates `{ id: "admin", label: "Admin console" }` to `roles: ["admin"]`, while nav.ts:108 admits program_manager and program_associate to `setup`. A PM or PA who reaches step 4 is therefore instructed to use a screen that RequireNav (src/client/routes/guards.tsx:33-41) refuses them, and no Admin console item appears in their sidebar to follow.
- **Fix** — Make the EmptyState role-aware in SetupWizard.tsx TeamStep: for admin/superuser keep the text and add an actual `<Link to="/app/admin">` (it is currently unlinked prose); for the read-only and cohorts seats, say instead that adding team members is a Super User / Admin action and name who to ask. ### F1089 · `P1` · /api/messages has no founder or mentor gate — the internal team channel is readable by external founders
*panel-contactteam — role-gating · effort S · found on review*

- **Gap** — Founders hold real sessions (the repo says so itself at support.ts:101-107: 'founders … legitimately hold a session for the portal'), and the mentor user-type does too. Because the messages router applies only requireAuth, a founder or mentor can call GET /api/messages?scope=team and read the entire internal Collaborate channel — every message any staff member broadcast in that edition — and POST into it, and can also POST /api/tickets into the Admin queue. The client route guard (guards.tsx:29-44) hides the screen but the API is directly reachable, and the repo's stated model is that 'the API enforces authZ independently'. The role harness has no probe for these endpoints, so nothing catches it. This is the same class of defect as the mentor-authorization fixes already applied elsewhere via denyMentor.
- **Prototype** — Contact team / Contact Admin are internal-only screens: they exist only in the 10 staff role files (panel-contactteam.html) and the founder has no such panel — the founder prototype is the isolated portal overlay `#fp-ov` / `fp-*` in _rest.html, which contains no Collaborate screen. The repo encodes the same intent at src/shared/nav.ts:120-124 + 203-205 ('Founder portal (isolated)').
- **Repository** — src/server/routes/support.ts:253-254 — `const messages = new Hono<AppEnv>(); messages.use("*", requireAuth);` (no denyMentor, no denyFounder), contrast :103 `issues.use("*", requireAuth, denyMentor)` + :106-108 denyFounder; support.ts:62 POST /api/tickets is likewise bare requireAuth. scripts/role-matrix.ts:423-475 has probes for tickets.list / issues.list / issues.file / issues.triage but NO probe for /api/messages at all.
- **Fix** — Add `denyMentor` to the messages router and a denyFounder check on both messages handlers (and denyMentor on POST /api/tickets), then add messages.read / messages.send probes to scripts/role-matrix.ts so the matrix covers them.
